direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-06-rcs-29195-respuesta-holly
direct_evidence.body:
Hello Holly,

Thank you for confirming that the Smart Alert History on case 26-288-15 is blank, and for your patience while we looked into this.

My current read is that the alert is working as it is configured. The Property Damage smart alert is set up to send only when the case has a Report Narrative, and case 26-288-15 does not have one yet, so the alert was skipped when the case was saved.

Whenever you have a moment, could you add the Report Narrative to case 26-288-15 and save it? The alert is checked each time the case is saved, so it should go out to the team at that point.

If you would prefer the alert to send even when the narrative is empty, that condition lives in the alert's Build Filters, and I am happy to walk through it with you.

Once the case is saved, I will confirm on this ticket that the alert went through.

Thank you again, and just reply here if anything looks off on your side.

Kiran, 12:04 a 12:05 p.m.:
"I agree, looks like it is similar issue. May be retriggering might help. Of course make sure before you proceed."
"The hotfix we pushed last Saturday? That is a valid fix."
"If that does not solve this ticket then it might be a different issue."
"Also, dont treat every smart alert ticket from the Saturday angle. Always look at the smart alert. See the filter they set."

Regla que deja: en cada ticket de Smart Alerts, revisar primero la configuracion y el filtro de la alerta, linea 6a en Grafana y SmartAlertConfig. El deadlock del mecanismo 8 no es la explicacion por defecto. PR 58273 sigue valido segun Kiran.

Agregado despues, Kiran:
"Smart alerts wont be triggered when the filter conditions are not met. So, start with looking at smart alert filter and then DB verification and then logs and so on."

SELECT * FROM incident.SmartAlertProcess WHERE ShopliftingID = <ID> ORDER BY RunDate DESC;
